topPRs.title: feat: add betanet task for revshare
topPRs.author: 0xChin
topPRs.body:
Summary                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - Adds task 060-betanet-rev-share to upgrade and enable Revenue Share on the Betanet L2 chain (revshare-beta-0, chainId: 420120033)                                                                                 
  - The task deploys RevShare contract implementations and upgrades fee vault proxies to enable automated revenue sharing                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  Details                                                                                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  This task enables the Revenue Share feature on Betanet by:                                                                                                                                                          
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  1. Deploying contract implementations:                                                                                                                                                                              
    - FeeVaults (Sequencer, Base, L1, Operator)                                                                                                                                                                       
    - FeeSplitter                                                                                                                                                                                                     
    - L1Withdrawer (pointing to FeesDepositor on L1: 0xed9B99a703BaD32AC96FDdc313c0652e379251Fd)                                                                                                                      
    - SuperchainRevenueShareCalculator (pointing to L1Withdrawer and ChainFeesRecipient)                                                                                                                              
  2. Upgrading fee vault proxies:                                                                                                                                                                                     
    - SequencerFeeVault, BaseFeeVault, L1FeeVault, OperatorFeeVault                                                                                                                                                   
  3. Configuring revenue sharing:                                                                                                                                                                                     
    - Sets FeeSplitter predeploy to use the new implementation                                                                                                                                                        
    - Initializes with RevShareCalculator address                                                                                                                                                                     
    - Min withdrawal amount: 2 ETH                                                                                                                                                                                    
    - Withdrawal gas limit: 800,000                                                                                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  Acceptance Tests                                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  The acceptance tests for this task are the post-task assertions in test/integration/RevSharePostTaskAssertions.t.sol. These tests should be run after task execution to validate the upgrade was successful:        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                      
  - test_assertRevShareState() - Validates L2 RevShare contract state (FeeSplitter configuration, L1Withdrawer settings, calculator addresses)                                                                        
  - test_withdrawalFlow() - End-to-end test of the withdrawal mechanism:                                                                                                                                              
    - Part 1: Funds vaults below threshold, verifies no withdrawal triggers                                                                                                                                           
    - Part 2: Funds vaults above threshold, verifies withdrawal initiates and funds route through L1 to OP L2

topPRs.title: fix(SuperchainAddressRegistry): support op-contracts v6.0.0 gameArgs + mark U18-uni sepolia executed
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
Prompt for claude to fix the failing tests as a result of the U18 upgrade. After this prompt the diff was large and clunky, so I had to prompt it a bit more to do the refactor you see to simplify the code in the SuperchainAddressRegistry

```
look at the trace for "f t --mt testSuperchainAddressesLoaded -vvv" and help me debug the failure. this failure did not occur until today when unichain ran an upgrade on sepolia, so I think we have to change something about the code. here are some hints about what changed in U18 that I think is the cause:

The CANNON and CANNON_KONA game types should use the same DelayedWETH proxy, with the PERMISSIONED_CANNON game type using a separate DelayedWETH proxy.

PR https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18244

This PR made the following changes:
Adds a DelayedWETH parameter to SystemConfig so OPCMv2 can be configured to have all dispute games share the same DelayedWETH contract
The AnchorStateRegistry initializer function now has the “retirement timestamp” only set to the current timestamp if the value has not already been set. In effect, this means the variable will only be modified the first time the contract is initialized.

note that PR is from ~/prj/optimism, you may need to look there to understand the Packages/contracts-bedrock/src diff between op-contracts v5.0.0 and op-contracts v6.0.0-rc.1
```

Prompt for claude to fix the U18 readme and execution status

```
I think the cause is because Unichain executed upgrade 18 which bumped their nonce. So we need to look at the safe and look at the Etherscan transaction history for that safe to find this transaction execution and update the README to say the status is executed with a link to the transaction hash like we do in other executed tasks
```

This is in draft because I have not yet actually reviewed the code to make sure it's clean, optimal, with accurate comments. I will either do that tomorrow or if someone wants to do that and make any changes, take over ownership of this PR, I can review afterwards 

---

## Summary

- Adds support for op-contracts v6.0.0 (OPCMv2) where dispute game parameters are stored in `DisputeGameFactory.gameArgs(gameType)` instead of the individual dispute game contracts
- Updates address discovery functions to check `gameArgs` first, then fall back to dispute game getters for backwards compatibility with older contract versions
- Fixes test failures for Unichain Sepolia after U18 upgrade

## Background

In op-contracts v6.0.0 introduced by [PR #18244](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18244):
- The `gameArgs` mapping in `DisputeGameFactory` now stores packed parameters for each game type
- Individual dispute game contracts (e.g., `FaultDisputeGame`, `PermissionedDisputeGame`) may return `address(0)` for `weth()`, `vm()`, `anchorStateRegistry()`, `challenger()`, and `proposer()`
- The actual values are decoded from the `gameArgs` bytes using the `LibGameArgs` layout

## Changes

1. Added `gameArgs(GameType)` to `IFetcher` interface
2. Updated the following functions to decode from `gameArgs` first:
   - `getDelayedWETHProxy` - weth at bytes 72-91
   - `getAnchorStateRegistryProxy` - ASR at bytes 52-71
   - `getMips` - VM at bytes 32-51
   - `getChallenger` - challenger at bytes 144-163 (permissioned only)
   - `getProposer` - proposer at bytes 124-143 (permissioned only)

## Test plan

- [x] `forge test --match-test testSuperchainAddressesLoaded` passes for both Sepolia and Mainnet
- [x] Verified Unichain Sepolia correctly resolves addresses from `gameArgs`
- [x] Verified backwards compatibility with pre-v6.0.0 chains (Mainnet)

topPRs.title: Check that the signer is an owner in just sign-stack
topPRs.author: alcueca
topPRs.body: `just sign` has a check that the signer is an owner of the safe, but `just sign-stack` is missing the same check. This PR fixes it.
